+  1| # Rentwise
+  2| 
+  3| Rentwise is the back-office API of a small equipment rental shop: power tools, camping gear,
+  4| photo equipment and garden machines. It is a FastAPI service with in-memory storage, seeded
+  5| with demo data on start-up.
+  6| 
+  7| This README is the **specification**. Where the code and this document disagree, the code
+  8| is wrong.
+  9| 
+ 10| ## Running
+ 11| 
+ 12| ```sh
+ 13| pytest -q          # tests
+ 14| ruff check .       # lint
+ 15| ```
+ 16| 
+ 17| `app.main:create_app(store=None, clock=None)` builds an application. By default it uses a
+ 18| freshly seeded `Store` and the system clock; tests inject a `FixedClock` pinned to
+ 19| 2025-06-02 (`app.seed.SEED_TODAY`).
+ 20| 
+ 21| ## Layout
+ 22| 
+ 23| | Path | Purpose |
+ 24| | --- | --- |
+ 25| | `app/models.py` | Pydantic models and enums |
+ 26| | `app/storage.py` | In-memory repositories, `Store`, seed loader |
+ 27| | `app/seed.py` | Demo data |
+ 28| | `app/clock.py` | Injectable "today" |
+ 29| | `app/errors.py` | Domain exceptions -> HTTP errors |
+ 30| | `app/services/` | Business rules (catalog, customers, availability, pricing, reservations, returns, invoices, reports) |
+ 31| | `app/api/routes.py` | All HTTP routes |
+ 32| 
+ 33| ## Domain rules
+ 34| 
+ 35| ### Dates
+ 36| 
+ 37| All date ranges are **half-open** `[start, end)`. A reservation's `end` is exclusive: the
+ 38| item is back in the shop on the morning of `end`. So a reservation ending on day X and
+ 39| another starting on day X for the same item do **not** overlap and are both allowed.
+ 40| The number of rental days is `end - start`.
+ 41| 
+ 42| ### Items
+ 43| 
+ 44| An item has `id`, `name`, `category` (a category id), `daily_rate`, `deposit` (money) and
+ 45| `status`: `available`, `maintenance` or `retired`.
+ 46| 
+ 47| - Only `available` items can be reserved.
+ 48| - Retiring an item is permanent; a retired item cannot change status again.
+ 49| - New items must reference an existing category; `daily_rate` must be positive.
+ 50| 
+ 51| ### Catalog search
+ 52| 
+ 53| `GET /items` lists items ordered by id.
+ 54| 
+ 55| - `q`: case-insensitive substring match on the item name (`"tent"` finds
+ 56|   "Two-Person Tent" and "Family Tent").
+ 57| - `category`: exact category id.
+ 58| - Pagination: first skip `offset` matching items, then return at most `limit` items
+ 59|   (`limit` 1..100, default 20; `offset` >= 0, default 0). `total` is the number of
+ 60|   matching items before pagination.
+ 61| 
+ 62| ### Customers
+ 63| 
+ 64| A customer has `id`, `name`, `email` (unique, case-insensitive, stored lower-case) and
+ 65| `tier`: `regular`, `silver` or `gold`.
+ 66| 
+ 67| ### Reservations
+ 68| 
+ 69| A reservation has `item_id`, `customer_id`, `start`, `end`, optional `coupon_code` and
+ 70| `status`: `active`, `cancelled` or `returned`.
+ 71| 
+ 72| - `end` must be after `start`; a reservation may last at most 90 days.
+ 73| - `start` may not be in the past (today is allowed).
+ 74| - The item and customer must exist; an unknown coupon code is rejected (422).
+ 75| - The item must be `available`.
+ 76| - **An item cannot have overlapping active reservations.** Two ranges overlap when they
+ 77|   share at least one day, i.e. `a.start < b.end and b.start < a.end`. This includes a new
+ 78|   range that starts inside, ends inside, exactly matches, or fully contains an existing one.
+ 79| - **Only `active` reservations block an item.** Cancelled and returned reservations never
+ 80|   affect availability.
+ 81| - Only `active` reservations can be cancelled or returned.
+ 82| 
+ 83| `GET /availability?item_id&start&end` answers whether a reservation for that range would be
+ 84| accepted, with a reason and the ids of the conflicting reservations.
+ 85| 
+ 86| ### Pricing
+ 87| 
+ 88| - `days = end - start`. One day is free for every **full** 7 days:
+ 89|   `billable_days = days - days // 7` (7 days -> 6 billable, 14 -> 12).
+ 90| - Rental amount = `daily_rate * billable_days`.
+ 91| - Tier discount: regular 0%, silver 5%, gold 15%.
+ 92| - Coupons (`POST /coupons`): an upper-case alphanumeric code with a percent off (1..100).
+ 93| - Tier and coupon discounts **add up** (silver 5% + 10% coupon = 15%) and the combined
+ 94|   discount is **capped at 30%** (gold 15% + 20% coupon = 30%, not 35%).
+ 95| - Discounts apply **only to the rental amount** and are applied **before tax**.
+ 96| - Tax is 20% of the discounted subtotal.
+ 97| 
+ 98| ### Returns
+ 99| 
+100| `POST /reservations/{id}/return` with optional `returned_on` (defaults to today) and
+101| `damaged` flag.
+102| 
+103| - `returned_on` cannot be before `start` or after today.
+104| - `late_days = max(0, returned_on - end)`. Returning on the `end` date (or earlier) is on
+105|   time: 0 late days. Returning on `end + 1` is 1 late day.
+106| - Late fee = `daily_rate * 1.5 * late_days`.
+107| - Damaged: the whole deposit is withheld and the item goes to `maintenance`. Otherwise the
+108|   deposit is refunded in full.
+109| - Early returns are not refunded: the rental is charged for the booked range.
+110| 
+111| ### Invoices
+112| 
+113| `GET /reservations/{id}/invoice` (active or returned reservations; cancelled ones have no
+114| invoice, 409).
+115| 
+116| - Lines: a `rental` line (quantity = billable days) and, for late returns, a `late_fee`
+117|   line (quantity = late days).
+118| - `subtotal` = sum of line amounts.
+119| - `discount` = rental line amount * combined discount rate (tier + coupon, capped at 30%).
+120| - `tax` = 20% of `subtotal - discount`.
+121| - `total` = `subtotal - discount + tax`.
+122| - Money is a decimal, rounded to 0.01 with ROUND_HALF_UP only when a figure is produced
+123|   (each line amount, discount, tax, total) - never on intermediate rates.
+124| 
+125| Example: gold customer, Family Tent (35.00/day), 5 days: subtotal 175.00, discount 26.25,
+126| tax 29.75, total 178.50.
+127|

+"""Service functions for maintenance windows."""
+
+from datetime import date
+
+from app.exceptions import ConflictError, NotFoundError
+from app.models import ItemStatus, MaintenanceWindow, MaintenanceWindowCreate
+from app.storage import Store
+
+
+def schedule_window(
+    store: Store,
+    item_id: int,
+    window_data: MaintenanceWindowCreate,
+) -> MaintenanceWindow:
+    """Schedule a new maintenance window for an item."""
+    item = store.items.get(item_id)
+    if item is None:
+        raise NotFoundError(f"item {item_id} not found")
+
+    # Check for overlap with active reservations
+    for reservation in store.reservations.for_item(item_id):
+        if reservation.status == ReservationStatus.ACTIVE and (
+            window_data.start < reservation.end
+            and reservation.start < window_data.end
+        ):
+            raise ConflictError(
+                f"maintenance window overlaps active reservation {reservation.id}"
+            )
+
+    # Create and store the new window
+    window = MaintenanceWindow(
+        id=store.maintenance_windows.allocate_id(),
+        item_id=item_id,
+        **window_data.model_dump(),
+    )
+    store.maintenance_windows.insert(window)
+    return window
+
+
+def list_windows(store: Store, item_id: int) -> list[MaintenanceWindow]:
+    """List all maintenance windows for an item, ordered by start date."""
+    item = store.items.get(item_id)
+    if item is None:
+        raise NotFoundError(f"item {item_id} not found")
+
+    return store.maintenance_windows.for_item(item_id)

+"""Service functions for maintenance windows."""
+
+from app.exceptions import ConflictError, NotFoundError
+from app.models import MaintenanceWindow, MaintenanceWindowCreate, ReservationStatus
+from app.storage import Store
+
+
+def schedule_window(
+    store: Store,
+    item_id: int,
+    window_data: MaintenanceWindowCreate,
+) -> MaintenanceWindow:
+    """Schedule a new maintenance window for an item."""
+    item = store.items.get(item_id)
+    if item is None:
+        raise NotFoundError(f"item {item_id} not found")
+
+    # Check for overlap with active reservations
+    for reservation in store.reservations.for_item(item_id):
+        if reservation.status == ReservationStatus.ACTIVE and (
+            window_data.start < reservation.end
+            and reservation.start < window_data.end
+        ):
+            raise ConflictError(
+                f"maintenance window overlaps active reservation {reservation.id}"
+            )
+
+    # Create and store the new window
+    window = MaintenanceWindow(
+        id=store.maintenance_windows.allocate_id(),
+        item_id=item_id,
+        **window_data.model_dump(),
+    )
+    store.maintenance_windows.insert(window)
+    return window
+
+
+def list_windows(store: Store, item_id: int) -> list[MaintenanceWindow]:
+    """List all maintenance windows for an item, ordered by start date."""
+    item = store.items.get(item_id)
+    if item is None:
+        raise NotFoundError(f"item {item_id} not found")
+
+    return store.maintenance_windows.for_item(item_id)

+ 35| ### Dates

+ 39| another starting on day X for the same item do **not** overlap and are both allowed.

+ 41| 
+ 42| ### Items
+ 43| 
+ 44| An item has `id`, `name`, `category` (a category id), `daily_rate`, `deposit` (money) and

+ 46| 
+ 47| - Only `available` items can be reserved.
+ 48| - Retiring an item is permanent; a retired item cannot change status again.

+ 52|

+ 61|

+ 63| 
+ 64| A customer has `id`, `name`, `email` (unique, case-insensitive, stored lower-case) and
+ 65| `tier`: `regular`, `silver` or `gold`.
+ 66| 
+ 67| ### Reservations
+ 68| 
+ 69| A reservation has `item_id`, `customer_id`, `start`, `end`, optional `coupon_code` and
+ 70| `status`: `active`, `cancelled` or `returned`.
+ 71| 
+ 72| - `end` must be after `start`; a reservation may last at most 90 days.
+ 73| - `start` may not be in the past (today is allowed).
+ 74| - The item and customer must exist; an unknown coupon code is rejected (422).
+ 75| - The item must be `available`.
+ 76| - **An item cannot have overlapping active reservations.** Two ranges overlap when they

+ 87| 
+ 88| - `days = end - start`. One day is free for every **full** 7 days:

+105|   time: 0 late days. Returning on `end + 1` is 1 late day.

+107| - Damaged: the whole deposit is withheld and the item goes to `maintenance`. Otherwise the

+"""Service functions for maintenance windows."""
+
+
+from app.exceptions import ConflictError, NotFoundError
+from app.models import MaintenanceWindow, MaintenanceWindowCreate
+from app.storage import Store
+
+
+def schedule_window(
+    store: Store,
+    item_id: int,
+    window_data: MaintenanceWindowCreate,
+) -> MaintenanceWindow:
+    """Schedule a new maintenance window for an item."""
+    item = store.items.get(item_id)
+    if item is None:
+        raise NotFoundError(f"item {item_id} not found")
+
+    # Check for overlap with active reservations
+    for reservation in store.reservations.for_item(item_id):
+        if reservation.status == ReservationStatus.ACTIVE and (
+            window_data.start < reservation.end
+            and reservation.start < window_data.end
+        ):
+            raise ConflictError(
+                f"maintenance window overlaps active reservation {reservation.id}"
+            )
+
+    # Create and store the new window
+    window = MaintenanceWindow(
+        id=store.maintenance_windows.allocate_id(),
+        item_id=item_id,
+        **window_data.model_dump(),
+    )
+    store.maintenance_windows.insert(window)
+    return window
+
+
+def list_windows(store: Store, item_id: int) -> list[MaintenanceWindow]:
+    """List all maintenance windows for an item, ordered by start date."""
+    item = store.items.get(item_id)
+    if item is None:
+        raise NotFoundError(f"item {item_id} not found")
+
+    return store.maintenance_windows.for_item(item_id)

-## Layout
-
-| Path | Purpose |
-| --- | --- |
-| `app/models.py` | Pydantic models and enums |
-| `app/storage.py` | In-memory repositories, `Store`, seed loader |
-| `app/seed.py` | Demo data |
-| `app/clock.py` | Injectable "today" |
-| `app/errors.py` | Domain exceptions -> HTTP errors |
-| `app/services/` | Business rules (catalog, customers, availability, pricing, reservations, returns, invoices, reports) |

-
-## Domain rules
-
-### Dates
-
-All date ranges are **half-open** `[start, end)`. A reservation's `end` is exclusive: the
-item is back in the shop on the morning of `end`. So a reservation ending on day X and
-another starting on day X for the same item do **not** overlap and are both allowed.
-The number of rental days is `end - start`.
-
-### Items
-
-An item has `id`, `name`, `category` (a category id), `daily_rate`, `deposit` (money) and
-`status`: `available`, `maintenance` or `retired`.
-
-- Only `available` items can be reserved.
-- Retiring an item is permanent; a retired item cannot change status again.
-- New items must reference an existing category; `daily_rate` must be positive.
-
-### Catalog search
-
-`GET /items` lists items ordered by id.
-
-- `q`: case-insensitive substring match on the item name (`"tent"` finds
-  "Two-Person Tent" and "Family Tent").
-- `category`: exact category id.
-- Pagination: first skip `offset` matching items, then return at most `limit` items
-  (`limit` 1..100, default 20; `offset` >= 0, default 0). `total` is the number of
-  matching items before pagination.
-
-### Customers
-
-A customer has `id`, `name`, `email` (unique, case-insensitive, stored lower-case) and
-`tier`: `regular`, `silver` or `gold`.
-
-### Reservations
-
-A reservation has `item_id`, `customer_id`, `start`, `end`, optional `coupon_code` and
-`status`: `active`, `cancelled` or `returned`.
-
-- `end` must be after `start`; a reservation may last at most 90 days.
-- `start` may not be in the past (today is allowed).
-- The item and customer must exist; an unknown coupon code is rejected (422).
-- The item must be `available`.
-- **An item cannot have overlapping active reservations.** Two ranges overlap when they
-  share at least one day, i.e. `a.start < b.end and b.start < a.end`. This includes a new
-  range that starts inside, ends inside, exactly matches, or fully contains an existing one.
-- **Only `active` reservations block an item.** Cancelled and returned reservations never
-  affect availability.
-- Only `active` reservations can be cancelled or returned.
-
-`GET /availability?item_id&start&end` answers whether a reservation for that range would be
-accepted, with a reason and the ids of the conflicting reservations.
-
-### Pricing
-
-- `days = end - start`. One day is free for every **full** 7 days:
-  `billable_days = days - days // 7` (7 days -> 6 billable, 14 -> 12).
-- Rental amount = `daily_rate * billable_days`.
-- Tier discount: regular 0%, silver 5%, gold 15%.
-- Coupons (`POST /coupons`): an upper-case alphanumeric code with a percent off (1..100).
-- Tier and coupon discounts **add up** (silver 5% + 10% coupon = 15%) and the combined
-  discount is **capped at 30%** (gold 15% + 20% coupon = 30%, not 35%).
-- Discounts apply **only to the rental amount** and are applied **before tax**.
-- Tax is 20% of the discounted subtotal.
-
-### Returns
-
-`POST /reservations/{id}/return` with optional `returned_on` (defaults to today) and
-`damaged` flag.
-
-- `returned_on` cannot be before `start` or after today.
-- `late_days = max(0, returned_on - end)`. Returning on the `end` date (or earlier) is on
-  time: 0 late days. Returning on `end + 1` is 1 late day.
-- Late fee = `daily_rate * 1.5 * late_days`.
-- Damaged: the whole deposit is withheld and the item goes to `maintenance`. Otherwise the
-  deposit is refunded in full.
-- Early returns are not refunded: the rental is charged for the booked range.
-
-### Invoices
-
-`GET /reservations/{id}/invoice` (active or returned reservations; cancelled ones have no
-invoice, 409).
-
-- Lines: a `rental` line (quantity = billable days) and, for late returns, a `late_fee`
-  line (quantity = late days).
-- `subtotal` = sum of line amounts.
-- `discount` = rental line amount * combined discount rate (tier + coupon, capped at 30%).
-- `tax` = 20% of `subtotal - discount`.
-- `total` = `subtotal - discount + tax`.
-- Money is a decimal, rounded to 0.01 with ROUND_HALF_UP only when a figure is produced
-  (each line amount, discount, tax, total) - never on intermediate rates.
-
-Example: gold customer, Family Tent (35.00/day), 5 days: subtotal 175.00, discount 26.25,
-tax 29.75, total 178.50.
-
-### Reports
-
-- `GET /reports/revenue?start&end`: net revenue (invoice total minus tax) per category for
-  reservations whose `start` falls in `[start, end)`. **Cancelled reservations are
-  excluded**; active and returned ones count.
-- `GET /reports/utilization?start&end`: for every non-retired item, the number of days in
-  `[start, end)` covered by active or returned reservations and that as a percentage of the
-  period (one decimal, half up). Cancelled reservations do not count.

+ 20| ## Layout
+ 21| 
+ 22| | Path | Purpose |
+ 23| | --- | --- |
+ 24| | `app/models.py` | Pydantic models and enums |
+ 25| | `app/storage.py` | SQLite repositories, `Store`, seed loader |

+ 31| 
+ 32| ## Domain rules
+ 33| 
+ 34| ### Dates
+ 35| 
+ 36| All date ranges are **half-open** `[start, end)`. A reservation's `end` is exclusive: the
+ 37| item is back in the shop on the morning of `end`. So a reservation ending on day X and
+ 38| another starting on day X for the same item do **not** overlap and are both allowed.
+ 39| The number of rental days is `end - start`.
+ 40| 
+ 41| ### Items
+ 42| 
+ 43| An item has `id`, `name`, `category` (a category id), `daily_rate`, `deposit` (money) and
+ 44| `status`: `available`, `maintenance` or `retired`.
+ 45| 
+ 46| - Only `available` items can be reserved.
+ 47| - Retiring an item is permanent; a retired item cannot change status again.
+ 48| - New items must reference an existing category; `daily_rate` must be positive.
+ 49| 
+ 50| ### Catalog search
+ 51| 
+ 52| `GET /items` lists items ordered by id.
+ 53| 
+ 54| - `q`: case-insensitive substring match on the item name (`"tent"` finds
+ 55|   "Two-Person Tent" and "Family Tent").
+ 56| - `category`: exact category id.
+ 57| - Pagination: first skip `offset` matching items, then return at most `limit` items
+ 58|   (`limit` 1..100, default 20; `offset` >= 0, default 0). `total` is the number of
+ 59|   matching items before pagination.
+ 60| 
+ 61| ### Customers
+ 62| 
+ 63| A customer has `id`, `name`, `email` (unique, case-insensitive, stored lower-case) and
+ 64| `tier`: `regular`, `silver` or `gold`.
+ 65| 
+ 66| ### Reservations
+ 67| 
+ 68| A reservation has `item_id`, `customer_id`, `start`, `end`, optional `coupon_code` and
+ 69| `status`: `active`, `cancelled` or `returned`.
+ 70| 
+ 71| - `end` must be after `start`; a reservation may last at most 90 days.
+ 72| - `start` may not be in the past (today is allowed).
+ 73| - The item and customer must exist; an unknown coupon code is rejected (422).
+ 74| - The item must be `available`.
+ 75| - **An item cannot have overlapping active reservations.** Two ranges overlap when they
+ 76|   share at least one day, i.e. `a.start < b.end and b.start < a.end`. This includes a new
+ 77|   range that starts inside, ends inside, exactly matches, or fully contains an existing one.
+ 78| - **Only `active` reservations block an item.** Cancelled and returned reservations never
+ 79|   affect availability.
+ 80| - Only `active` reservations can be cancelled or returned.
+ 81| 
+ 82| `GET /availability?item_id&start&end` answers whether a reservation for that range would be
+ 83| accepted, with a reason and the ids of the conflicting reservations.
+ 84| 
+ 85| ### Pricing
+ 86| 
+ 87| - `days = end - start`. One day is free for every **full** 7 days:
+ 88|   `billable_days = days - days // 7` (7 days -> 6 billable, 14 -> 12).
+ 89| - Rental amount = `daily_rate * billable_days`.
+ 90| - Tier discount: regular 0%, silver 5%, gold 15%.
+ 91| - Coupons (`POST /coupons`): an upper-case alphanumeric code with a percent off (1..100).
+ 92| - Tier and coupon discounts **add up** (silver 5% + 10% coupon = 15%) and the combined
+ 93|   discount is **capped at 30%** (gold 15% + 20% coupon = 30%, not 35%).
+ 94| - Discounts apply **only to the rental amount** and are applied **before tax**.
+ 95| - Tax is 20% of the discounted subtotal.
+ 96| 
+ 97| ### Returns
+ 98| 
+ 99| `POST /reservations/{id}/return` with optional `returned_on` (defaults to today) and
+100| `damaged` flag.
+101| 
+102| - `returned_on` cannot be before `start` or after today.
+103| - `late_days = max(0, returned_on - end)`. Returning on the `end` date (or earlier) is on
+104|   time: 0 late days. Returning on `end + 1` is 1 late day.
+105| - Late fee = `daily_rate * 1.5 * late_days`.
+106| - Damaged: the whole deposit is withheld and the item goes to `maintenance`. Otherwise the
+107|   deposit is refunded in full.
+108| - Early returns are not refunded: the rental is charged for the booked range.
+109| 
+110| ### Invoices
+111| 
+112| `GET /reservations/{id}/invoice` (active or returned reservations; cancelled ones have no
+113| invoice, 409).
+114| 
+115| - Lines: a `rental` line (quantity = billable days) and, for late returns, a `late_fee`
+116|   line (quantity = late days).
+117| - `subtotal` = sum of line amounts.
+118| - `discount` = rental line amount * combined discount rate (tier + coupon, capped at 30%).
+119| - `tax` = 20% of `subtotal - discount`.
+120| - `total` = `subtotal - discount + tax`.
+121| - Money is a decimal, rounded to 0.01 with ROUND_HALF_UP only when a figure is produced
+122|   (each line amount, discount, tax, total) - never on intermediate rates.
+123| 
+124| Example: gold customer, Family Tent (35.00/day), 5 days: subtotal 175.00, discount 26.25,
+125| tax 29.75, total 178.50.
+126| 
+127| ### Reports
+128| 
+129| - `GET /reports/revenue?start&end`: net revenue (invoice total minus tax) per category for
+130|   reservations whose `start` falls in `[start, end)`. **Cancelled reservations are
+131|   excluded**; active and returned ones count.
+132| - `GET /reports/utilization?start&end`: for every non-retired item, the number of days in
+133|   `[start, end)` covered by active or returned reservations and that as a percentage of the
+134|   period (one decimal, half up). Cancelled reservations do not count.
+135| 
+136| ## API
+137| 
+138| | Method | Path | Notes |
+139| | --- | --- | --- |
+140| | GET | `/health` | status and current date |

+142| | GET | `/items` | `q`, `category`, `limit`, `offset` |
